# The Graph Academy

> A community-owned learning site for The Graph protocol. Role-based paths that
> explain why the protocol is designed as it is, checked against the Horizon-era
> protocol and stamped with the date somebody checked.

This site is deliberately not a documentation clone and not a dashboard.

- For procedures, CLI reference and configuration: https://thegraph.com/docs/en/
- For live network data: https://thegraph.com/explorer and https://www.lodestar-dashboard.com

## How to read this site accurately

Every protocol number lives in one registry rather than being written into prose.
Each lesson carries the date it was last verified, the sources it was verified
against, and a date by which it should be checked again. A page past that date
renders a warning banner.

Where two official sources contradict each other, this site records the conflict
rather than picking a winner. As of 2026-08-30 there are three such cases, all
listed at /parameters/.

## Structure

- /paths/ - all seven learning paths
- /start/ - Foundations, for readers new to the protocol
- /delegators/ /curators/ /indexers/ /developers/ /consumers/ /governance/ - role paths
- /parameters/ - every protocol number, with source, quote and date read
- /glossary/ - terms, including obsolete ones, labelled as such
- /changelog/ - protocol changes and corrections to this site
- /about/ - what this site is and is not
